y-m-31-04.title: Singathini ngokuqinisekileyo xa sisazi kuphela umndilili nokuphambuka okuqhelekileyo?
y-m-31-04.topic: Oko umndilili nokuphambuka okuqhelekileyo kodwa banokukuxela
y-m-31-04.goal: Wahlule oko kunokuthethwa ngokuqinisekileyo, oko kunokwenzeka kodwa kungaqinisekanga, noko ufuna ukukwazi ngakumbi xa kunikwe kuphela umndilili nokuphambuka okuqhelekileyo, uze ufumane ngokwakho amaxabiso angenakwenzeka.
y-m-31-04.material: Umndilili wovavanyo lwemathematika (amanqaku e-0 ukuya kwi-100, amanqaku ngamanani aphelele) olwathathwa ngabafundi abangama-30 beklasi enye kwibanga le-9 lesikolo yimanqaku angama-70, kwaye ukuphambuka okuqhelekileyo kungamanqaku ama-5. Amanqaku omntu ngamnye awaziwa. Aba bafundi abangama-30 beklasi bonke ngabantu abaphandwayo, ngoko ukwahluka (= 25) lixabiso elifunyenwe ngokwahlula ngama-30. Ngoko ukuba udibanisa zonke izikwere zokuphambuka zabafundi abangama-30, yi-25×30=750.
